f.title: Report ADRs discovered in accordance with the rules
f.statement: Drug manufacturers (including overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions shall report the adverse drug reactions they discover in accordance with the regulations.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产企业（包括进口药品的境外制药厂商）、药品经营企业、医疗机构应当按照规定报告所发现的药品不良反应。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers (including overseas pharmaceutical manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions shall report the adverse drug reactions they discover in accordance with the regulations.

f.title: Establish an ADR reporting and monitoring management system
f.statement: Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall establish an ADR reporting and monitoring management system (internal rules).
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.exceptions: Failure is penalised under Art 58(1)(i) (manufacturers) and Art 59 (distributors).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构应当建立药品不良反应报告和监测管理制度。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall establish an adverse drug reaction reporting and monitoring management system.

f.title: Set up a dedicated PV unit with full-time staff (manufacturers)
f.statement: Drug manufacturers shall set up a dedicated unit and assign full-time staff to carry out the company's ADR reporting and monitoring work.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturer (药品生产企业), including the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (MAH under the 2019 DAL)
rows.quote: 药品生产企业应当设立专门机构并配备专职人员
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. Quote is the manufacturer clause; the purpose (to carry out the unit's ADR reporting and monitoring) is in the rest of the same sentence.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers shall set up a dedicated body and assign full-time personnel

f.title: Set up or designate a PV unit with full- or part-time staff (distributors)
f.statement: Drug distributors (and medical institutions) shall set up or designate a unit and assign full-time or part-time staff to carry out their ADR reporting and monitoring work.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug distributor (药品经营企业); also medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品经营企业和医疗机构应当设立或者指定机构并配备专（兼）职人员，承担本单位的药品不良反应报告和监测工作。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Drug distributors and medical institutions shall set up or designate a body and assign full-time (or part-time) personnel to undertake the unit's adverse drug reaction reporting and monitoring work.

f.title: Ensure PV staff have relevant professional knowledge
f.statement: Staff engaged in ADR reporting and monitoring shall have relevant professional knowledge in medicine, pharmacy, epidemiology, statistics or similar disciplines and be able to analyse and evaluate ADRs scientifically.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Organisations engaged in ADR reporting and monitoring (their PV staff)
rows.quote: 从事药品不良反应报告和监测的工作人员应当具有医学、药学、流行病学或者统计学等相关专业知识，具备科学分析评价药品不良反应的能力。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Personnel engaged in adverse drug reaction reporting and monitoring shall have relevant professional knowledge such as medicine, pharmacy, epidemiology or statistics, and have the ability to scientifically analyse and evaluate adverse drug reactions.

f.title: Report ADRs through the national ADR monitoring information network
f.statement: When drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions learn of or discover an adverse reaction possibly related to drug use, they shall report it through the national ADR monitoring information network. Where online reporting is not possible, they shall submit a paper form to the local ADR monitoring institution, which reports it online on their behalf.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.exceptions: Paper report via the local ADR monitoring institution only where online reporting conditions are lacking.
f.systems: National ADR monitoring information network (国家药品不良反应监测信息网络)

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构获知或者发现可能与用药有关的不良反应，应当通过国家药品不良反应监测信息网络报告；不具备在线报告条件的，应当通过纸质报表报所在地药品不良反应监测机构，由所在地药品不良反应监测机构代为在线报告。
systems: National ADR monitoring information network (国家药品不良反应监测信息网络)
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Where drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions learn of or discover adverse reactions possibly related to drug use, they shall report them through the national adverse drug reaction monitoring information network; where they do not have the conditions for online reporting, they shall report through paper forms to the local adverse drug reaction monitoring institution, which shall report online on their behalf.

f.title: Ensure ADR report content is true, complete and accurate
f.statement: The content of ADR reports shall be true, complete and accurate.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.processes: ICSR quality control; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 报告内容应当真实、完整、准确。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. Actor from the preceding paragraph of Art 15.
rows.quote_en: The content of reports shall be true, complete and accurate.

f.title: Cooperate with ADR and cluster event investigations and provide data
f.statement: Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions shall cooperate with investigations of ADRs or cluster adverse events by drug regulatory departments, health administrative departments and ADR monitoring institutions, and provide the materials required for the investigation.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构应当配合药品监督管理部门、卫生行政部门和药品不良反应监测机构对药品不良反应或者群体不良事件的调查，并提供调查所需的资料。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall cooperate with the investigation of adverse drug reactions or cluster adverse events by drug regulatory departments, health administrative departments and adverse drug reaction monitoring institutions, and provide the materials required for the investigation.

f.title: Establish and keep ADR reporting and monitoring records
f.statement: Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions shall establish and keep ADR reporting and monitoring files (archives).
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构应当建立并保存药品不良反应报告和监测档案。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall establish and keep adverse drug reaction reporting and monitoring archives.

f.title: Actively collect, record, analyse, handle and report individual ADRs
f.statement: Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions shall actively collect adverse drug reactions; after learning of or discovering an ADR they shall record it in detail, analyse and handle it, complete the "Adverse Drug Reaction/Event Report Form" (Annex 1) and report it.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构应当主动收集药品不良反应，获知或者发现药品不良反应后应当详细记录、分析和处理，填写《药品不良反应/事件报告表》（见附表1）并报告。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall actively collect adverse drug reactions, and after learning of or discovering an adverse drug reaction shall record, analyse and handle it in detail, complete the "Adverse Drug Reaction/Event Report Form" (see Annex 1) and report it.

f.title: Report all ADRs for domestic drugs in the new-drug monitoring period; new and serious for others
f.statement: For domestically produced drugs within the new-drug monitoring period, all adverse reactions to the drug shall be reported; for other domestically produced drugs, new and serious adverse reactions shall be reported.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 新药监测期内的国产药品应当报告该药品的所有不良反应；其他国产药品，报告新的和严重的不良反应。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. Actor inferred from Art 19 (the same reporters).
rows.quote_en: For domestically produced drugs within the new drug monitoring period, all adverse reactions of the drug shall be reported; for other domestically produced drugs, new and serious adverse reactions shall be reported.

f.title: Report all ADRs for imported drugs for 5 years from first import approval; new and serious thereafter
f.statement: For imported drugs, all adverse reactions shall be reported within 5 years from the date the drug was first approved for import; after 5 years, new and serious adverse reactions shall be reported.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 进口药品自首次获准进口之日起5年内，报告该进口药品的所有不良反应；满5年的，报告新的和严重的不良反应。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; re-translation agrees. Double-check: the paragraph has no explicit modal; it continues the 应当 of the first paragraph, so Mandatory. Actor inferred from Art 19.
rows.quote_en: For imported drugs, within 5 years from the date of first approval for import, all adverse reactions of the imported drug shall be reported; after 5 years, new and serious adverse reactions shall be reported.

f.title: Report new or serious ADRs within 15 days
f.statement: Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions that discover or learn of a new or serious adverse drug reaction shall report it within 15 days.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.deadline: Within 15 days of discovering or learning of the ADR
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构发现或者获知新的、严重的药品不良反应应当在15日内报告
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. Origin domestic: overseas cases have their own Section 4 rule (Art 33). 日 read as calendar days (no 工作日).
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions that discover or learn of new or serious adverse drug reactions shall report them within 15 days

deadline_rule.applies_to: new or serious ADRs (domestic reports under Chapter III Section 2; overseas serious ADRs follow Art 33)

f.title: Report ADR death cases immediately
f.statement: Among new or serious ADRs, death cases must be reported immediately.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 其中死亡病例须立即报告
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. 须 = must. No fixed number, so no deadline_rule.
rows.quote_en: of which death cases must be reported immediately

f.title: Report other ADRs within 30 days
f.statement: Adverse drug reactions other than new or serious ones shall be reported within 30 days.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 其他药品不良反应应当在30日内报告
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. Clock start taken from the same sentence (发现或者获知).
rows.quote_en: other adverse drug reactions shall be reported within 30 days

deadline_rule.applies_to: ADRs other than new or serious ones that are within the reporting scope of Art 20

f.title: Report follow-up information promptly
f.statement: Where follow-up information is available, it shall be reported promptly.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 有随访信息的，应当及时报告。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. 及时 = promptly; no deadline_rule.
rows.quote_en: Where there is follow-up information, it shall be reported promptly.

f.title: Investigate death cases and submit an investigation report within 15 days
f.statement: Drug manufacturers shall investigate death cases they learn of, obtaining details of the case's basic information, drug use, and the occurrence, diagnosis and treatment of the adverse reaction, and complete an investigation report within 15 days and submit it to the provincial ADR monitoring institution where the manufacturer is located.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Medical review; Submission operations

rows.actor: Drug manufacturer (药品生产企业), including the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (MAH under the 2019 DAL)
rows.quote: 药品生产企业应当对获知的死亡病例进行调查，详细了解死亡病例的基本信息、药品使用情况、不良反应发生及诊治情况等，并在15日内完成调查报告，报药品生产企业所在地的省级药品不良反应监测机构。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal. The text does not state the clock start explicitly; 获知 (learning of the death case) is the trigger in the sentence.
rows.quote_en: Drug manufacturers shall investigate death cases they learn of, find out in detail the basic information of the death case, drug use, occurrence of the adverse reaction and its diagnosis and treatment, etc., complete the investigation report within 15 days, and report it to the provincial adverse drug reaction monitoring institution where the manufacturer is located.

deadline_rule.applies_to: death cases learned of by the manufacturer (investigation report)

f.title: Report drug cluster adverse events immediately by phone or fax and online
f.statement: After learning of or discovering a drug cluster adverse event, drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions shall immediately report it by telephone, fax or similar to the county-level drug regulatory department, health administrative department and ADR monitoring institution where they are located (and may report to higher levels where necessary); at the same time they shall complete the "Drug Cluster Adverse Event Basic Information Form" (Annex 2) and, for each case, promptly complete the "Adverse Drug Reaction/Event Report Form" and report it through the national ADR monitoring information network.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.exceptions: May report to a higher level directly where necessary (permitted).
f.systems: National ADR monitoring information network (国家药品不良反应监测信息网络)
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; Signal management

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors and medical institutions
rows.quote: 药品生产、经营企业和医疗机构获知或者发现药品群体不良事件后，应当立即通过电话或者传真等方式报所在地的县级药品监督管理部门、卫生行政部门和药品不良反应监测机构，必要时可以越级报告；同时填写《药品群体不良事件基本信息表》（见附表2），对每一病例还应当及时填写《药品不良反应/事件报告表》，通过国家药品不良反应监测信息网络报告。
data_elements: Drug Cluster Adverse Event Basic Information Form (Annex 2)
systems: National ADR monitoring information network (国家药品不良反应监测信息网络)
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: After learning of or discovering a drug cluster adverse event, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall immediately report it by telephone, fax or other means to the local county-level drug regulatory department, health administrative department and adverse drug reaction monitoring institution, and where necessary may report directly to a higher level; at the same time they shall complete the "Drug Cluster Adverse Event Basic Information Form" (see Annex 2), and for each case shall also promptly complete the "Adverse Drug Reaction/Event Report Form" and report it through the national adverse drug reaction monitoring information network.

f.title: Investigate a cluster adverse event and report within 7 days
f.statement: After learning of a drug cluster adverse event, the drug manufacturer shall immediately investigate, obtaining details of the event, drug use, patient diagnosis and treatment, and the manufacture, storage and distribution of the drug and previous similar events, and complete an investigation report within 7 days and submit it to the provincial drug regulatory department and ADR monitoring institution where it is located.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturer (药品生产企业), including the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (MAH under the 2019 DAL)
rows.quote: 药品生产企业获知药品群体不良事件后应当立即开展调查，详细了解药品群体不良事件的发生、药品使用、患者诊治以及药品生产、储存、流通、既往类似不良事件等情况，在7日内完成调查报告，报所在地省级药品监督管理部门和药品不良反应监测机构
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force (应当 = shall) and numbers. Double-check: statement stays within the quote; level follows the Chinese modal.
rows.quote_en: After learning of a drug cluster adverse event, the drug manufacturer shall immediately carry out an investigation, find out in detail the occurrence of the cluster adverse event, drug use, patient diagnosis and treatment, and the production, storage and distribution of the drug, previous similar adverse events, etc., complete the investigation report within 7 days, and report it to the local provincial drug regulatory department and adverse drug reaction monitoring institution

deadline_rule.clock_start: 获知药品群体不良事件

f.title: Self-inspect after a cluster event and suspend or recall the drug if necessary
f.statement: At the same time the drug manufacturer shall promptly carry out a self-inspection, analyse the cause of the cluster event, and where necessary suspend production, sale and use of the drug and recall it, and report this to the provincial drug regulatory department where it is located.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Quality system & CAPA; Submission operations

rows.actor: Drug manufacturer (药品生产企业), including the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (MAH under the 2019 DAL)
rows.quote: 同时迅速开展自查，分析事件发生的原因，必要时应当暂停生产、销售、使用和召回相关药品，并报所在地省级药品监督管理部门。

f.statement: For serious adverse drug reactions occurring outside China with imported or domestic drugs (including those collected by spontaneous reporting systems, found in post-marketing clinical studies and reported in the literature), the drug manufacturer shall complete the "Overseas Adverse Drug Reaction/Event Report Form" (Annex 3) and submit it to the National ADR Monitoring Center within 30 days from the date of awareness.

f.statement: Where an imported or domestic drug is suspended from sale or use, or withdrawn, outside China because of adverse drug reactions, the drug manufacturer shall report this in writing to the national drug regulatory authority (SFDA, now NMPA) and the National ADR Monitoring Center within 24 hours of becoming aware.

f.title: Prepare periodic safety update reports
f.statement: Drug manufacturers shall periodically summarise and analyse the ADR reports and monitoring data for the drugs they manufacture, summarise domestic and foreign safety information, carry out a risk-benefit assessment, and write a periodic safety update report (PSUR). The writing specification for PSURs is set by the National ADR Monitoring Center.

f.statement: For drugs confirmed to have caused serious adverse reactions, drug manufacturers shall promptly inform healthcare professionals, patients and the public of the ADR and rational-use information through all effective channels, and take measures such as amending the label and package insert, suspending production, sale and use, and recall, to reduce and prevent recurrence of the ADR.

f.title: Definition: serious adverse drug reaction
f.statement: A serious adverse drug reaction is a reaction caused by use of a drug that results in any of: death; a threat to life; cancer, teratogenicity or birth defects; significant or permanent disability or impairment of organ function; hospitalisation or prolonged hospitalisation; or other important medical events which, without treatment, might lead to one of these outcomes.

（三）严重药品不良反应，是指因使用药品引起以下损害情形之一的反应： 

 　　1.导致死亡； 

 　　2.危及生命； 

 　　3.致癌、致畸、致出生缺陷； 

 　　4.导致显著的或者永久的人体伤残或者器官功能的损伤； 

 　　5.导致住院或者住院时间延长； 

 　　6.导致其他重要医学事件，如不进行治疗可能出现上述所列情况的。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim (line breaks as in the text). Binding definition that drives the 15-day rule, so Mandatory per GUIDE. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: (3) A serious adverse drug reaction means a reaction caused by the use of a drug that results in one of the following harms: 1. death; 2. danger to life; 3. carcinogenicity, teratogenicity or birth defects; 4. significant or permanent human disability or impairment of organ function; 5. hospitalisation or prolongation of hospitalisation; 6. other important medical events which, if not treated, may lead to the situations listed above.

f.title: Definition: new adverse drug reaction (unlisted or more severe than labelled)
f.statement: A new adverse drug reaction is one not stated in the package insert. A reaction described in the insert but whose nature, severity, outcome or frequency differs from or is more serious than described is handled as a new adverse drug reaction.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions (applies when classifying ADRs)
rows.quote: （四）新的药品不良反应，是指药品说明书中未载明的不良反应。说明书中已有描述，但不良反应发生的性质、程度、后果或者频率与说明书描述不一致或者更严重的，按照新的药品不良反应处理。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; binding definition driving reporting scope and timelines, Mandatory per GUIDE. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: (4) A new adverse drug reaction means an adverse reaction not stated in the drug package insert. Where it is already described in the package insert but the nature, severity, consequence or frequency of the adverse reaction is inconsistent with or more serious than described in the package insert, it shall be handled as a new adverse drug reaction.

f.title: Definition: drug cluster adverse event and "same drug"
f.statement: A drug cluster adverse event is an event in which the same drug, during use, causes harm or a threat to the health or life of a certain number of people within a relatively concentrated time and area and requires urgent handling. "Same drug" means a drug of the same name, dosage form and strength made by the same manufacturer.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.actor: Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions (applies when identifying cluster events)
rows.quote:
（五）药品群体不良事件，是指同一药品在使用过程中，在相对集中的时间、区域内，对一定数量人群的身体健康或者生命安全造成损害或者威胁，需要予以紧急处置的事件。 

 　　同一药品：指同一生产企业生产的同一药品名称、同一剂型、同一规格的药品。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; binding definition triggering Arts 27-30. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: (5) A drug cluster adverse event means an event in which the same drug, during use, causes damage or threat to the physical health or life safety of a certain number of people within a relatively concentrated time and area and requires emergency handling. Same drug: a drug of the same name, same dosage form and same strength produced by the same manufacturer.

f.title: Overseas manufacturers may delegate ADR duties to a China office or agent
f.statement: The overseas manufacturer of an imported drug may entrust its representative office in China or an agent in China to perform ADR reporting and monitoring obligations as set for drug manufacturers in these Measures.
f.applicability: China; Measures for the Administration of ADR Reporting and Monitoring (MOH Order No. 81, in force from 1 July 2011). "药品生产企业" (drug manufacturer) includes the overseas manufacturer of an imported drug (Art 3); since the 2019 Drug Administration Law these company duties are carried by the MAH. Vaccine ADR rules issued separately prevail (Art 65).

rows.quote: 进口药品的境外制药厂商可以委托其驻中国境内的办事机构或者中国境内代理机构，按照本办法对药品生产企业的规定，履行药品不良反应报告和监测义务。

rows.quote_en: The overseas pharmaceutical manufacturer of an imported drug may entrust its representative office in China or an agent in China to perform the adverse drug reaction reporting and monitoring obligations in accordance with the provisions of these Measures for drug manufacturers.

dates.title: MOH Order No. 81 (ADR Reporting and Monitoring Measures): takes effect
dates.scope: Drug manufacturers (incl. overseas manufacturers of imported drugs), drug distributors, medical institutions and authorities in China; repeals SFDA Order No. 7 (2004)
